topic: How does the hierarchical classification framework impact satellite link budget margins when prioritizing QoS-sensitive traffic?
consensus_response: Hierarchical classification frameworks prioritize QoS-sensitive traffic based on latency requirements, introducing overhead and reducing capacity. Adaptive coding and modulation schemes mitigate these effects, optimizing transmission parameters for prioritized traffic. Beamforming techniques further enhance signal quality, minimizing interference.
reference_context: QoS provisioning in converged satellite and terrestrial networks requires consideration of high fixed latencies and link characteristics.
